title: Multi-channel Workflow Part 2
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Allocate reservoir wells
steps.instruction: Allocate reservoir wells as follows: use one wash‑buffer reservoir well per sample column; use one equilibration‑buffer reservoir well per six sample columns; use one elution‑buffer reservoir well per elution buffer plate. This protocol performs steps 41.2‑end of the referenced SOP (https://opentrons-protocol-library-website.s3.amazonaws.com/custom-README-images/00c517-multi/VIB-UGENT_Customized_protocol_S-trap_steps_Multi.xlsx).

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter your protocol parameters in the input fields provided above.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol file and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: Upload your custom labware files (.json) to the Opentrons App by navigating to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and selecting the files, if needed.

substeps.instruction: Select More > Custom Labware > Add Labware
Choose the .json labware files to upload

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol Python file (.py) to the Opentrons App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the Opentrons App; consult the support articles for calibration tips.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button to execute the protocol.
